observations.head_motion: Small left/right attention and downward pitch are visibly distinct while retaining the source cat shape.
observations.eye_nose_mouth_ear_contours: No visible holes, tears, separated facial features or severe stretching at the inspected trial extrema.
observations.eyes_and_mouth: Static features of the original textured skin. No independent eye rotation, blinking, eyelid overlay or mouth motion added.
observations.chest_surface: Existing scan/mesh faceting remains visible in the white throat/chest region and is also present in the V3 comparison.
observations.mobile: At 390x844, action and view controls remain visible and operable; the face fits within the viewport with no horizontal overflow.

limitations: This is a restrained head-only attention experiment, not a facial rig.
The source cat's captured asymmetry and surface quality remain.
At slow acceleration the yaw envelope contracts from 8 degrees at rest to 4 degrees by 0.15 m/s; this avoids a sudden amplitude jump on starting.
